admin.intro.en: Choose the AI service for this installation. Learners can keep using the form without AI.
admin.intro.am: ለዚህ ጭነት የኤአይ አገልግሎት ይምረጡ። ተማሪዎች ያለ ኤአይ ቅጹን መጠቀም ይችላሉ።

admin.modelHint.en: Enter a model available in your provider account.

admin.keyHint.en: Leave blank to keep the saved key for this provider. Keys are stored encrypted on the server.
admin.keyHint.am: የተቀመጠውን ቁልፍ ለማቆየት ባዶ ይተዉት። ቁልፎች በሰርቨሩ ላይ ተመስጥረው ይቀመጣሉ።

admin.keySaved.en: A key is saved. Its value is never returned here.

admin.endpointHint.en: For Ollama or custom REST only. Your server operator must approve this exact URL.
admin.endpointHint.am: ለኦላማ ወይም ለብጁ REST ብቻ። የሰርቨር አስተዳዳሪዎ ይህን አድራሻ መፍቀድ አለበት።

admin.limit.am: በቀን የሚፈቀድ ከፍተኛ የኤአይ ጥያቄ ብዛት

admin.testHint.en: Testing sends a small example request to the selected provider and may incur an API charge. It does not send learner information.
admin.testHint.am: ሙከራው ትንሽ የምሳሌ ጥያቄ ይልካል፤ የኤፒአይ ክፍያ ሊኖር ይችላል። የተማሪ መረጃ አይልክም።

admin.saved.en: Settings saved. Learners will be asked again before using the changed provider.
admin.saved.am: ቅንብሮች ተቀምጠዋል። ተማሪዎች የተቀየረውን አቅራቢ ከመጠቀማቸው በፊት እንደገና ይጠየቃሉ።

admin.tested.en: Connection works and returned a valid Roha action. Settings have not been saved.

admin.error.en: Could not complete this action. Check the server configuration and try again.
admin.error.am: ይህን ማጠናቀቅ አልተቻለም። የሰርቨሩን ቅንብር ያረጋግጡና እንደገና ይሞክሩ።

admin.signInAgain.en: Sign in again to continue. Your provider settings are unchanged.
admin.signInAgain.am: ለመቀጠል እንደገና ይግቡ። የአቅራቢ ቅንብሮችዎ አልተቀየሩም።

admin.changed.en: Settings changed in another session. Reload the page before saving.
admin.changed.am: ቅንብሮች በሌላ ክፍለ ጊዜ ተቀይረዋል። ከማስቀመጥዎ በፊት ገጹን እንደገና ይክፈቱ።

admin.embedHint.en: This assistant operates supported controls already on your page. Keep your form accessible. Allow the script, stylesheet and API origins in your site policy.
admin.embedHint.am: ይህ ረዳት በገጽዎ ላይ ያሉ የሚደገፉ መቆጣጠሪያዎችን ይጠቀማል። ቅጽዎ ተደራሽ መሆኑን ያረጋግጡ።
